verdict.why_winner: B automates a genuinely outdated, high-dollar workflow (chasing customs duty refunds through broker/carrier paperwork) that Ramp does not ship, uses data Ramp Bill Pay already ingests, and can be demoed end to end with synthetic broker invoices: parse, match duty lines to entries, size recoverable amounts, draft claims, post journal entries. ideas.label: B

It also extends Ramp's existing duplicate detection instead of duplicating it, which maximizes the technical-execution and demo-polish weights.

verdict.why_winner: D is the most buildable, verifiable, and Ramp-native of the six: synthetic pay apps and returned waiver PDFs make a fully real end-to-end demo, the validation logic (catching edited statutory text, mismatched through-dates and G703 amounts) is concrete technical work that can be shown failing and passing on stage, and the payoff moment — Ramp for Construction's payment gate flipping green without a human chasing anyone — is a clear, honest automation of a workflow that is still email-and-PDF everywhere.
